units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:8">Sot. III, 8</cite> <he>האיש פורע ופוֹרֵם … פורעת ופוֹרֶמֶת</he> the (leprous) man must let his hair grow and tear his garments, but a woman should not &c.; Sifra Thazr. Par. 5, ch. XII; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:8:1">Y. Sot. III, end, 19ᵇ</cite>.

Hor. III, 5 כהן גדול פורם מלמטה וכ׳ the high priest in mourning tears his lower garments; ib. 12ᵇ אינו פורם … פּוֹרְמִין he does not tear his garments in the manner ordinary people in mourning do; Sifra Emor ch. I, Par. 2; Yoma 73ᵃ; a. fr.—Part. pass. פָּרוּם; f. פְּרוּמָה; pl. פְּרוּמִים, פְּרוּמִין; פְּרוּמוֹת exposed, bare.

<cite ref="Gittin 90b:1">Gitt. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>ופ׳ משני צדדיה</he> bare on both her shoulders; Y. ib. IX, end, 50ᵈ <he>צדדיה פרומין</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:1:3">Y. Sot. I, beg. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>מְפוֹרָמִין</he>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="Q01867">same</cite>. Part. pass. <he>מְפוֹרָם</he>; pl. <he>מְפוֹרָמִין</he>, v. supra.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:13">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>, end <he>כמפרים</he> some ed., v. <cite ref="Q01908"><he>פָּרַס</he></cite>.]
